buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN.

c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Generic End User Certificate: Wherever Bidders are insisting for End User Certificate from the Buyer, same shall be provided in Buyer’s standard format only. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Mandatory Documentation. Comprehensive Certification: Submission of all certificates explicitly mentioned in this bid document is mandatory. Failure to p rovide even a single required certificate at the time of the Technical Bid opening will result in immediate summary rejection of the bid. 2. Only OEM Authorized Dealer/ Authorized Distributor shall participate in the bid. Valid OEM authorization certificate must be submitted along with the bid; ot herwise, the offer shall be rejected. 3 Bidder must have minimum 05 years of experience in supply, installation, testing, and commissioning work. 4. Bidder must submit Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheet, GST Registration, P AN Card, and ITR for last 03 years. 6. Flooring thickness, material specification, and technical data sheet must be s ubmitted with the bid. submission shall lead to rejection. 7. Complete scope includes site inspection, surface preparation, flooring, marki ng, steel poles, accessories and all allied civil works if required. 8. Bidder shall visit the site before quoting and submit site inspection certificate duly signed by buyer/consignee. 9. OEM warranty certificate must be submitted at the time of supply and installa tion. 10. Free preventive maintenance service minimum 02 visits per year during wa rranty period shall be mandatory. 11. Service support office / authorized service centre must be available in India. Documentary proof must be uploaded. 12. Delivery, installation, testing, and commissioning must be completed within stipulated period mentioned in bid. Delay shall attract LD penalty as per GeM/D efence procurement rules. 13. No subletting/subcontracting shall be allowed without prior written approval of Buyer. 14. Material supplied shall be new, unused, genuine, and of latest manufacture. Refurbished/repaired material shall be rejected. 15. Buyer reserves the right to conduct pre-dispatch inspection and post-installa tion inspection by Board of Officers.

16. Final acceptance shall be subject to successful inspection, testing, and satisf actory performance certification by consignee. 17. Payment shall be released only after complete supply, successful installatio n, inspection clearance, and acceptance by Board of Officers. 18. Any deviation from technical specifications or ATC shall result in summary r ejection of bid without further clarification. 19. In case of false documents, forged certificates, or misleading information, bi dder shall be blacklisted and legal action initiated as per Government rules. 20. All disputes shall be subject to jurisdiction of Buyer's station/formation only. 21. Buyer reserves full right to accept or reject any bid without assigning any re ason in the interest of service. .
